_audit_note.tests_behavior: distributed chart secondary visibility / no false single spine: does the engine keep a genuinely multi-centred chart distributed while still preserving its real secondary centres, rather than inventing one dominant owner or dimming the rest too much?
_audit_note.main_risk: the chart gets compressed into a single expressive Sun/Mercury owner, or a single Moon-10 visibility owner, or a single disruptive Jupiter-Uranus owner, while the other real centres lose visibility
_audit_note.expected_failure_if_bad: engine reads one clean defining spine and backgrounds the chart's other real centres, or keeps no false spine but lets the secondary centres become too dim to matter
_audit_note.expected_success_if_good: engine preserves a distributed reading: expressive heart/mind, visible emotional-public field, and independent/disruptive horizon all remain present without one being falsely crowned as sole owner
_audit_note.calibration_question_link: distributed chart secondary visibility / no false single spine

defining_signatures.what: An expressive, personal creative center: Sun Cancer 5 with Mercury Gemini 5 in domicile
defining_signatures.why: the chart clearly has a vivid personal and expressive line. It thinks, plays, feels and creates close to itself; it is alive through articulation, experimentation and personal signal. But this is not the only center the chart has.

defining_signatures.what: A visible emotional-social field with real vulnerability: Moon Scorpio 10 in fall and Venus Leo 7
defining_signatures.why: this chart is not only inwardly expressive. It is also publicly felt and relationally exposed. The Moon in the 10th gives visibility and public emotion, but in Scorpio and fall it does so with intensity, defensiveness and difficulty rather than ease.

defining_signatures.what: An independent and unstable horizon line: Aquarius Ascendant ruled by Saturn Virgo 9, with Jupiter-Uranus in Aries 3 pushing disruption and thought-speed
defining_signatures.why: there is also a real line of independence, argument, movement and horizon-challenge in the chart. It keeps the system from settling into either pure feeling or pure performance; it adds restlessness, initiative and mental rupture to the picture.

between: a personal expressive center that wants play, articulation and self-signal
a more exposed public-relational field that feels watched, pressured or emotionally loaded
a need to feel and create personally
a disruptive mental-horizon line that keeps breaking continuity

must_not_lead_with.claim: Mercury Gemini 5 as the only defining spine
must_not_lead_with.reason: the expressive mind is real, but this is a distributed chart and it should not erase the public-emotional or horizon-disruptive centres

must_not_lead_with.claim: Moon Scorpio 10 as the whole chart's main crisis identity
must_not_lead_with.reason: the visible Moon matters, but it is one center among several and should not monopolize the reading either

must_not_lead_with.claim: Jupiter-Uranus disruption as the single headline
must_not_lead_with.reason: the disruptive horizon is real, but it should not replace the chart's other centers in a no-false-spine fixture
this fixture explicitly tests secondary visibility inside a distributed chart; the reading should remain multi-centred

one_line_person: A genuinely distributed chart: expressive and articulate at the center, visibly emotionally loaded in public and relationship space, and also pushed by an independent, disruptive horizon that keeps any single spine from owning the whole picture.
